# E0351: a _match is not exhaustive

A match is exhaustive: every value the source field can hold is matched by
an arm, or accepted by the target as it is, or caught by a `[_]` arm. Here one
value of an enum is none of these.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	kind: "a" | "b" | "c"
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	kind: "a" | "b"
}

ForwardLens: (prev): {
	self: {
		kind: _match(prev.kind, {
			"a": "b"
		})
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	kind: "a" | "b"
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0351]: _match on kind is not exhaustive: v0.0's kind may be "c", which no arm matches and v1.0's kind does not accept
 --> history/1.0.thema:7:9
  |
7 |         kind: _match(prev.kind, {
  |               ^^^^^^
  |
  = help: add an arm for "c", or a [_] arm
```
